summary: The PlacementRequestCourseInfo class provides mechanisms to retrieve and populate details about course placement requests from a database session. It includes properties to store course-specific data such as ID, name, description, and various settings related to the placement context.
purpose: The purpose of PlacementRequestCourseInfo is to facilitate the retrieval and manipulation of data regarding course placement requests within a system, by interacting with a database to fill in details for specific course entries.

workflows.name: Get Placement Request Course Info
steps: Invoke GetInfo method with session and PRD_ID
Set procedure name in session DB to PlacementRequestCourseInfo
Add parameter PRD_ID to session DB
Execute session DB to get data reader
If data reader is not null and has rows, call FillPlacementRequestCourseInfo
Close data reader in session DB

workflows.name: Fill Placement Request Course Info
steps: Retrieve and set all course information fields from data reader

business_rules: If a course name is specified as 'Unknown' but was created by QES, translate it to a known resource value
conditions: Checking if data reader is not null and has rows
Conditionally set Discipline and SubDiscipline based on UseAltLanguageFields setting
system_behavior: Interacts with database to retrieve course information using stored procedures and parameters
Populates course information entities with data from database
